name: Lemon Squeezy
notes: Card fill proven on hosted checkouts in the 2026-06 campaign. The Stripe frame is unreachable whenever the page nests it inside an lemonsqueezy.com iframe, because the SDK's frameLocator is single-level. NOTE (2026-07-20): this is broader than 'embedded overlays on a merchant page' — two independent `<store>.lemonsqueezy.com/checkout/buy/<uuid>` pages both tripped the embedded path and returned gateway `lemonsqueezy-embedded-card-unreachable` at level `cart`, so LS's own checkout URLs are affected too. This is an SDK reach limitation, NOT a merchant dead-end: the stores are otherwise healthy and card-payable by a human. Nested-frameLocator support in the driving SDK would likely unblock the platform.

steps.addToCart: None — the checkout page renders directly. For pay-what-you-want, set a non-zero price (input[name=custom_price]) to switch the free flow to paid and mount the Stripe card frame.
steps.payment: Click the 'Card' tab, then a Stripe Payment Element (or split frames). Card-number token, then the CVV token into the payment/CVC frame immediately after.

gotchas: Some stores put Cloudflare Turnstile in front of checkout — detect and hand off, never solve.
